method: Six new text-conditioned Kimodo-SOMA-RP-v1.2 predictions. Three seeds for each side; generated judo/skate-style shoulder/side roll replaces the authored knee-hand collision brace.

unchanged.creator_approved: Front and back ukemi retained without rederivation.

generation.conditioning: Native idle full-body poses atframes0/137/149 with lateral destination+/-1.8m. Intervening fall and recovery generated from the text, not keyframed support-pose playback.
generation.text_encoder: Locally cached Meta Llama3/LLM2Vec on CPU, prompt embeddings cached locally; no remote video upload.
generation.peak_torch_gpu_allocation_scope: Allocated Torch tensors, not total system/GPU use.

runtime.seed_policy: Existing per-entry shuffle bag, no immediate repeat with alternatives; compared bodies share seed; hold chosen take through fall/recovery
runtime.controls: Hold Ctrl+A/D with canvas focused; grounded standing collision triggers side ukemi
runtime.low_hurdle: Continue across12–70cm grounded low solid only with clear rollout
runtime.tall_wall: Redirect away from wall into clear space and choose opposite side pool
runtime.blocked_route: No roll launched when sampled controller route is blocked
runtime.recording: Save take bakes source poses, controller travel, transitions and IK; variant-choice and side-object-ukemi events retain IDs/seeds; raw source exports omit runtime layers

target_cleanup: Per-body full-skin floor clearance envelope sampled at30Hz. Original generated/retargeted sources preserved. Not a learned balance or complete mesh/environment physics solve.

takes.prompt: A person standing upright loses balance and falls sideways to the left. They tuck their chin, bend their knees, land softly on their left side and shoulder, roll smoothly across their upper back in a judo side breakfall, then get back up to a relaxed standing posture.

conditioning.kind: Text-conditioned lateral breakfall with native idle start/end keyframes
